draft.inside_message: Six years with Advisory today, and the team is better for it. Thank you for the steady work, and for the bake sale you organise every autumn, which raises more than it has any right to. Good to have you here.

artwork_brief.style_note: large six, understated, brand colour on plain paper

flags: Signer and recipient share the first name Oliver; the card is addressed to Oliver Okonkwo and signed by Oliver Grant, which may read oddly in print.
draft.rationale: Names the six years and leans on the Macmillan bake sale, the one fact given, in a plain line-manager voice with a light touch.
